correctness.rationale: Direct case partition on clique labels 2 and 3 is disjoint and exhaustive: b>=1 or a>=2 gives automatic defense; b=0,a=1 forbids independent zeros and requires an outside 2 or 3 only when the other clique labels contain zero; a=b=0 forces all independent labels to be 2 or 3 and n>=2 defends all clique zeros. The polynomial and x=1 total follow, while the only weight-three functions use a universal clique label 3. Independent brute-force testing across r,n=2,3,4 examined 112896 complete label assignments and compared 171 coefficient slots and the exact total and minimum.
residual_risks: The actual RESULT.md Git blob contains 18 C0 control bytes (VT, backspace) in LaTex commands such as \vee and \bigl; its rendered scientific notation is damaged even though the intended formulas are unambiguous from adjacency, variables and verify.py. Requiring source-text sanitization before publication is a transport blocker, not a fabricated new scientific theorem.
The n=1/r=1 boundaries are deliberately excluded; Case 3 requires n>=2.

originality.rationale: The scalar minimum gamma_dR=3 on graphs with a universal vertex is explicitly prior-covered by Cariaga--Jamil Proposition 5 and the join result in Proposition 13, but the complete all-function weight polynomial, exact total, and r minimum-label count for K_r join independent_n were not found in the inspected primary literature. The closest published enumerator is quasi-total double Roman on complete multipartite graphs, a distinct support-restricted function class; it cannot enumerate unrestricted double Roman functions by parameter renaming.

residual_risks: Value is assessed for the exact final claim, not an extrapolation to arbitrary graph/variety families.

scientific_limitations: The closed formula requires r,n>=2; no all-boundary or arbitrary split-graph result is claimed.
